params.usage: 0-21:Triangle; 22-43: Square; 44-65: Saw Down; 66-87: Saw Up; 88-109: S&H; 110-127: Filter EG

params.desc: Adjusts the modulation amount to the VCOs

params.desc: Adjusts the modulation amount to the VCF

params.desc: Enables or disables the ability of the LFO to sync with MIDI CLOCK messages

params.usage: 0-6: 4 Whole Notes; 7-12: 3 Whole Notes; 13-18: 2 Whole Notes; 19-24: Whole Note + Half; 25-30: Whole Note; 31-36: Dotted 1/2 Note; 37-42: Whole Note Triplet; 43-48: 1/2 Note; 49-54: Dotted 1/4 Note Triplet; 55-60: 1/2 …

params.desc: Adjusts the level of the external audio input
